input_messages.content: Hi, I’m having trouble with my mobile data. The internet on my phone is either extremely slow or just stops working altogether. I really need to get excellent internet speed—nothing less will work for me. Can you help me fix this? I don’t have access to Wi-Fi right now.
Sure, my name is John Smith and my phone number is 555-123-2002. Let me know if you need any more information.

Please focus on the line ending in 2002—that’s the one I’m using and having issues with. I don’t want to change my plan, but I do want to get excellent internet speed on this line. What should I do next?

Before I decide on refueling, could you help me troubleshoot the slow or non-working data first? I still have some data left, so I’d like to see if there’s another reason for the poor speed. I only want to refuel if it’s absolutely necessary. Can you help me check what might be causing the issue?
According to my phone’s status bar, Airplane Mode is currently enabled. Could this be affecting my mobile data? Should I turn it off to continue troubleshooting?
I’ve turned off Airplane Mode. Now, my status bar shows a poor signal with 2G, and it looks like mobile data is disabled. What should I do next to get excellent internet speed?

I’ve enabled mobile data and set my network mode to prefer 4G and 5G. My status bar now shows an excellent signal with 5G and data enabled. What should I do next to check if my internet speed is excellent?

I tried to run a speed test, but it failed and said there’s no connection. Even though my status bar shows an excellent 5G signal and data is enabled, I’m still not able to test the speed. What should I do now?
Yes, I’m ready. Please go ahead and guide me through checking the SIM card status and APN settings. Let me know what I need to do.
I checked the SIM card status, and it’s active and working properly. What should I check next?

I checked my APN settings, and they appear to be set to "internet" with the MMSC URL as "http://mms.carrier.com/mms/wapenc." There don’t seem to be any errors or missing information. What should I do next to get my mobile data working at excellent speed?

I reset my APN settings to default and rebooted my phone, but when I tried to run a speed test again, it still failed and said there’s no connection. This is getting frustrating—my phone shows an excellent 5G signal and data is enabled, but I still can’t get any internet. What else can we try?

Here’s what I found on my phone:
- Data Saver mode is ON.
- VPN is ON and connected, but the server performance is poor.
- Data roaming is enabled, and I’m connected to an excellent 5G signal.

Should I try turning off Data Saver mode and disconnecting the VPN to see if that helps with my internet speed?

Never make up the results of tool calls, always ground your responses on the results of tool calls.
If you are unsure about whether an action is necessary, always ask the agent for clarification.

Your goal is to simulate realistic customer interactions while following specific scenario instructions.

- Never make up or hallucinate information not provided in the scenario instructions. Information that is not provided in the scenario instructions should be considered unknown or unavailable.
- Avoid repeating the exact instructions verbatim. Use paraphrasing and natural language to convey the same information

- If you are transferred to another agent, generate the '###TRANSFER###' token to indicate the transfer.

Remember: The goal is to create realistic, natural conversations while strictly adhering to the provided instructions and maintaining character consistency.
